spiritual_reading:
The whole essence of envy is the first inversion of life that arose in the state where falsity rules and good is absent.

Within that envy, the first good that comes forth to meet and resist evil was assaulted by the intoxicating delight of falsity and by active malice. The outer truths by which that good was protected and made present in the lowest degree were taken away and torn, so that what should have guarded and expressed inner good was distorted and drawn into the service of evil.

Envy then set itself against the first revealed manifestation of the Divine message, as it was presented from a higher degree in the form that envy was able to perceive. It fixed upon that manifestation a mark of possession and altered it into a merely external and self-derived likeness, and it impressed this falsified likeness upon the lowest life it could control, making an originating pattern within what it called its own generation.

After this, envy again turned itself against the first true human state. It took from that state a living capacity and brought it out from an external truth joined to good within that human life, separating it so that what should have served conjunction was made a source for a derivative formation under envy’s dominion.

fills.notes: The envy is treated as an active first nature. The substrate idiom regularly says a quality “is” or “exists” in something (state as container). The spiritual sense requires an indwelling active principle, not a mere description.

The envy “receives” the assaulting elements into itself: the intoxicating delight (poison) and evil-doing. This matches the correspondential idea that a perverted state takes in falsity as delight and then acts from it.
The garments correspond to outer truths. The required action is their being torn away. “Rent” (torn) directly matches the spiritual translation: taken away and torn.

The last clause must express distortion and subjection: truths pulled from their guarding function into the service of evil. “Drew them down” fits the inside-to-outside logic: lower degree domination by the dark state.

assessment: Most lacunae are trivial letter restorations. The only substantial uncertainties are in ¶2, where the correspondential constraints are clear: envy as an indwelling active state, an internal reception of poison and evil-doing, the rending of garments as the stripping and tearing of outer truths, and their being drawn downward into subservience. Exact verbs are less philologically constrained but are tightly bounded by the spiritual sequence (indwelling → assault/reception → tearing → downward drawing).
